entry.name: rnbo_tonormalized~
entry.digest: Define signal parameters for RNBO that can be accessed by the target platform.
entry.description: tonormalized~ will modify an input based on a provided mathematical expression from a param~ object sharing the same name. The input value will be clipped by the @min and @max values specified in param~ .

arguments.description: The parameter name to be shared with aobject.
